title: Turkish Braised Cabbage Boregi
description: A hearty, comforting Turkish dish featuring braised cabbage and crispy boregi pastry.
instructions: Heat su to a boil in a large saucepan.
Add cabbage and onion to the saucepan; cover and simmer until cabbage is tender.
Stir in caraway seeds, salt, and pepper.
Roll out boregi pastry and cut into squares.
Place a spoonful of the cabbage mixture onto one half of each square.
Fold the other half over the filling and press edges to seal.
Heat su in a large skillet and add the boregi.
Fry until golden brown and crispy.
Serve with a side of su for dipping.
